heroHeadline: Russia Launches Massive Zircon-Hypersonic Attack — 656 Drones + 73 Missiles Kill 22+; Ukraine Strikes Ilsky Refinery — Day 1,559
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,559 of Russia's full-scale invasion, Russia launched one of the war's largest combined aerial assaults: 656 Shahed-type drones + 73 missiles, including 8 Zircon hypersonic missiles — likely the most Zircons used in a single strike. Ukraine intercepted 602 drones and 40 missiles, but the assault killed at least 22 people and wounded 100+ across Kyiv, Dnipro, Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv, Poltava, Khmelnytskyi, and Sumy regions. Kyiv's Podil district saw a nine-story apartment block ablaze; Mayor Klitschko reported power outages. The Kremlin declared the war had entered a 'different paradigm,' calling Ukraine's actions 'inhumane acts of terror' while simultaneously claiming Russia remains open to negotiations. Zelensky issued a direct appeal to President Trump, stating U.S. help is 'absolutely necessary' and requesting additional Patriot air defense systems. Simultaneously, Ukrainian long-range drones struck the Ilsky oil refinery in Krasnodar, Russia — the 19th Russian energy facility struck in 2026 — pushing cumulative Russian energy sector losses past $10B and maintaining the 2026 campaign that has knocked out ~40% of Russia's refining capacity. The front line recorded 178 combat engagements with the Pokrovsk sector absorbing 36 Russian assault attempts. Russian cumulative losses reached ~1,366,910 (+1,440 in 24 hours), with 1,583 Russian drones also destroyed.
